title: Partum Constructione
description: A fresh look at technical modpacks
body:
This is a tech modpack that combines three core mods: Create, Mekanism, and Ad Astra. Here’s what it offers:

### Create  
- Build complex machinery using gears, conveyors, steam engines, and automated factories.  
- New recipes are added for integration with other mods.  

### Mekanism  
- Automate everything with digital miners, nuclear reactors, quantum entangloporters, and tiered factories.  


### Ad Astra  
- Explore new planets, build rockets, mine unique resources in space, and automate resource extraction on alien worlds using Create and Mekanism.  

---

### Mod Compatibility  
- Recipes and mechanics have been overhauled for synergy. For example, Mekanism parts are used to craft rockets in Ad Astra.  

---

### Endless Creativity  
- From constructing steam-powered mills to designing interplanetary logistics systems—combine technologies as you see fit.  

---

### Meaningful Progression  
- Start with basic mechanisms in Create, advance to nuclear power in Mekanism, then use those resources to colonize the galaxy in Ad Astra.  

---

### Stunning Landscapes  
- Reterraforged and Regions Unexplored enhance the world with breathtaking mountains, golden rye fields, and vibrant meadows.
